label: Qwen Code
description: One conversation with Qwen Code, Alibaba's coding agent: three conversations are three nodes. Wire `agent` and `stream` into an AskAgent and talk to it in a Loop; end the loop with a CloseBus on `stream`, which ends this node's part of the run. With no `computer`, Qwen Code runs on your machine (a local install only) with your own login, working in `folder`. If `qwen` is missing, weft installs it into a folder of its own, shared by the whole machine, before the node runs. With a `computer` wired, it is installed and run inside that computer, which a cloud install needs, and it logs in with the connection on `access`. Refusing one of its permission requests ends its whole turn. With a connection, its background extras that cost model calls on every turn (its managed memory and follow-up suggestions) are off. An Alibaba Cloud Coding Plan key works only through your machine's own login, and only while a person drives the conversation: its terms forbid automated use. Your program's tools reach the model under their own names, and one named like a Qwen Code tool takes that tool's place. Its card shows what it is doing and a Start over button. What is exposed: the permission mode, the model, the reasoning effort, instructions added to its system prompt and extra folders.

inputs.name: computer
inputs.description: A Computer to run Qwen Code in. Left out, it runs on your machine, which only a local install has. Several agents may share one computer.

inputs.name: access
inputs.description: A QwenCodeAccess's `access`: an OpenAI-compatible key (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, ...) or an Anthropic key. Required with a `computer`. Left out on your machine, Qwen Code uses the login already on it.

inputs.name: folder
inputs.label: Folder
inputs.description: The folder Qwen Code works in. On your machine it is required, and must exist. In a computer it is a path inside the computer, its home folder when left out.

inputs.name: program
inputs.label: Program
inputs.description: On your machine: the Qwen Code program to run, when it is not the `qwen` on your PATH or the one weft installs (an install of your own, a version you keep for this). A path on your machine, so it cannot go with a `computer`.

inputs.name: permission
inputs.label: Permissions
inputs.description: What Qwen Code may do without asking. `ask`: every edit and command comes out of AskAgent as a question. `accept_edits`: file edits go ahead, the rest asks. `auto`: a model classifier lets what it judges safe through and asks about the rest. `plan`: it only plans. `bypass`: nothing asks, nothing is refused; for a computer, which is the wall around it.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: The model to use, as the provider names it. Left out, Qwen Code's default for the login.

inputs.name: streamBy
inputs.label: Stream by
inputs.description: What goes out on `stream`: `message`, one event per whole message, tool use and result, so a run waiting on a long step sleeps; `token`, every piece of text as it is written too, which keeps the run awake while the agent writes.

inputs.name: effort
inputs.label: Reasoning effort
inputs.description: How hard the model thinks, for a model that reasons. Left out, the model's default.

inputs.name: appendSystemPrompt
inputs.label: Add to the system prompt
inputs.description: Instructions added to its system prompt, for every turn.

inputs.name: addDirs
inputs.label: Extra folders
inputs.description: Folders besides `folder` Qwen Code may read and change.

outputs.name: agent
outputs.description: The agent's handle: wire it into AskAgent's `agent`. Baked: made when the infra is started.

outputs.name: stream
outputs.description: Everything the agent does in this run, as AskAgent sends it. Wire it into every AskAgent of the loop, and into a CloseBus after the loop: the run's part of this node ends when it does.

then.message: QwenCode '{id}' runs on the machine weft runs on, which a cloud install does not have; wire a Computer into `computer`.
QwenCode '{id}' runs in a computer, where no login is waiting for it; give it a QwenCodeAccess on `access`.
QwenCode '{id}' works on your machine, so it needs a `folder` to work in.
QwenCode '{id}' has a `permission` it does not know; pick one of ask, accept_edits, auto, plan, bypass.
QwenCode '{id}' has a `streamBy` it does not know; pick message or token.
QwenCode '{id}' runs in a computer, where `program`, a path on your machine, means nothing; leave `program` out, the computer installs Qwen Code itself.
